sentences.text: 1.Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2.This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 22.4.2022 and cognizance order dated 14.3.2023 as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 461 of 2023 (State Vs. Hari Shanker and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 613 of 2021,
under Sections 498A, 323, 354(c), 354(A) IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Khair, District- Aligarh,
pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Khair, Aligarh.

sentences.text:
3.As per the allegation made in the first informant report, it is alleged that applicant was married to opposite party no. 2 on 2.3.2020, however, after the said marriage, the applicant started demanding additional dowry and for non-fulfilment of demand of additional dowry, they started torturing and Umesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112302021/
1 maltreating her and subjected her to cruelty and turned her out of her matrimonial home.
4.Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that from the perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, no offence is disclosed against the applicant and the present prosecution has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purposes of harassment.

entities.text: Umesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another

sentences.text: He has pointed out certain documents and statements in support of his contention.

5.Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that from the perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, prima facie, offence is clearly made out against the applicant.
6.Moreover, all the submissions made at the bar relates to the disputed question of fact, which cannot be adjudicated upon by this Court under Section 482 CrPC.

At this stage, only prima facie case is to be seen in the light of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the cases of R.P.
Kapur Vs. State of Punjab, AIR 1960 SC 866, State of Haryana Vs. Bhajan Lal, 1992 SCC (Cri.) 426,
State of Bihar Vs. P.P. Sharma, 1992 SCC (Cri.) 192 and lastly
